image_description: A European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) is shown from a top-down perspective, resting on a dark, wet substrate of decaying leaves and twigs. The salamander has a glossy black body with vivid yellow spots and stripes running along its back and tail. The skin appears moist and smooth, consistent with amphibian characteristics. The head is visible at the upper right, with the body extending diagonally toward the lower left. The tail is partially visible, extending toward the bottom left corner. The surrounding environment is dark and damp, typical of the salamander's natural habitat.
